counting_unit: one independently identified real-world incident or complaint episode; sources, URLs, records, case IDs and reposts do not increase the event count

events.identity_basis: UnitedHealth Group / Change Healthcare single cybersecurity incident; SEC, Optum, archived public references and Day 1/Day 2 case IDs all refer to this event
events.summary: Network incident affecting Change Healthcare, disclosed in an SEC filing and an Optum status update.
events.use_scope: Existing local Day 1/Day 2 materials may be reused for authorized restricted Day 5 offline checks. SEC and archive evidence were limited to internal time-isolation work; Optum material was limited to internal source linkage. No new external model transfer or redistribution is authorized.

time_evidence.meaning: conservative witness for original SEC accession
earlier Optum incident-page witness, Unix seconds

events.cutoff_limitation: Optum's incident-page witness predates the SEC witness. This cutoff is not 30 minutes after the earliest appearance of the overall incident; changing the observation target would require a new frozen protocol.
events.label_status: one SEC source has two existing human neutral annotations; their strict double-blind independence is not established; Optum has one non-blind initial annotation; no adjudicated direction label
events.exclusion_reason_for_formal_event_scorin: No adjudicated escalation/calming outcome in a frozen observation window and no paired qualifying direction prediction; historical SEC probe also exposed this event during development.

events.identity_basis: One verified Black Cat complaint ID and its merchant reply/completion timeline are one complaint episode, not multiple events
events.summary: Redacted insurance claim-handling complaint involving ZhongAn customer service.
events.use_scope: User-confirmed Black Cat sample authorization covers redacted local storage, model processing, demonstration and competition submission; this preparation only reads the existing local redacted package. New collection or external transfer requires separate scope check.

time_evidence.meaning: submission and review times do not establish historical anonymous visibility

events.label_status: source package contains a provisional single-reviewer sentiment suggestion; no independent sentiment truth or event direction label
events.exclusion_reason_for_formal_event_scorin: Historical anonymous public visibility before the outcome is unknown. The old 22:21 cutoff is invalid; single-complaint completion cannot prove public-opinion calming.

events.identity_basis: Three news summaries describe or repeat one ZhongAn marketing-call/text controversy; repost dates do not create additional events
events.summary: Reports about disputed marketing calls and text messages and consumer-council communication.
events.use_scope: Existing locally reviewed human summaries only; publisher permissions and any further collection, redistribution or model transfer must be checked source by source.

time_evidence.meaning: null: displayed publication time is not a historical visibility witness

events.label_status: no independent human sentiment labels or adjudicated direction label
events.exclusion_reason_for_formal_event_scorin: No contemporaneous visibility witness for the first report, so the historical cutoff cannot be qualified; later reposts are the same event and not independent direction truth.
